SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ODW_Provider_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2967_') AS ODW_Provider_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ODW_Provider_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2967_') AS ODW_Provider_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_Provider_Staging_ODW' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967_') AS PDS_Provider_Staging_Stage_Provider2967__sink_TableName;

SELECT  	PRPR.PRPR_ID                    PROV_PROVIDER_ID 	, PRPR.PRPR_ID					PROV_SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR 	, 'FAC'							PROV_SRC_SYS_CD 	, PRPR.PRPR_NPI					PROV_NATIONAL_PROVIDER_NBR 	, PRPR.PRPR_NAME                PROV_PROV_FULL_NM 	, PRPR.PRPR_MCTR_TYPE			PROV_PROV_FACILITY_TYPE_CD 	, PRPR.PRAD_ID                  PROV_PROV_ADDR_ID 	, PRPR.PRCR_ID                  PROV_PRAC_ID 	, PRAD.PRAD_ID					PROA_PROV_ADDR_ID 	, PRAD.PRAD_EFF_DT				PROA_PROV_ADDR_BEGIN_DT 	, PRAD.PRAD_TYPE				PROA_ADDRESS_TYPE_CD 	, 'FAC'							PROA_SRC_SYS_CD 	, PRAD.PRAD_TERM_DT             PROA_PROV_ADDR_END_DT 	, PRAD.PRAD_ADDR1				PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE1 	, PRAD.PRAD_ADDR2				PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE2 	, PRAD.PRAD_ADDR3				PROA_PROV_ADDR_LINE3 	, PRAD.PRAD_CITY                PROA_PROV_CITY_NM 	, NULL              PROA_PROV_COUNTY_CD 	, PRAD.PRAD_STATE               PROA_PROV_STATE_CD 	,CASE WHEN LEN(REPLACE(PRAD.PRAD_ZIP,'-','')) NOT IN (5,9) THEN NULL ELSE LEFT(PRAD.PRAD_ZIP,5) END PROA_PROV_ZIP5 	,CASE WHEN LEN(PRAD.PRAD_ZIP)>5 THEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(PRAD.PRAD_ZIP,'-',''),6,4) ELSE NULL END PROA_PROV_ZIP4 	, PRAD.PRAD_PHONE				PROA_PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_NBR 	, PRAD.PRAD_PHONE_EXT			PROA_PROV_OFFICE_PHONE_EXT 	, NULL							PROA_PROV_CELL_NBR 	, PRAD.PRAD_EMAIL               PROA_PROV_EMAIL 	,PRPR.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM              PROVIDER_SOURCE_UPDATE_DT 	,PRAD.PRAD_COUNTY              PROVIDER_COUNTY 	,'N'              PROV_LOGICAL_DELETE_IND 	,'N'              PROA_LOGICAL_DELETE_IND FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRPR_PROV PRPR 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS PRAD ON PRAD.PRAD_ID = PRPR.PRAD_ID 		AND PRAD.PRAD_TYPE = 'PRI' 	INNER JOIN ( 		SELECT PRAD_ID, MAX(PRAD_EFF_DT) as MAX_ADDR_DT 		FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_PRAD_ADDRESS 		WHERE (GETDATE() BETWEEN PRAD_EFF_DT and PRAD_TERM_DT) 		AND PRAD_TYPE = 'PRI' 		GROUP BY PRAD_ID 	) MAX_PRI_ADDR ON MAX_PRI_ADDR.PRAD_ID = PRAD.PRAD_ID         AND MAX_PRI_ADDR.MAX_ADDR_DT = PRAD.PRAD_EFF_DT
